titre: Un parc de logements qui vieillit sans interruption
sous_titre: Âge médian des logements occupés par leur propriétaire aux États-Unis, en années, 2005 à 2024

2005.texte: The median age of owner-occupied homes climbed to 42 years old in 2024, up from 31 in 2005

2022.texte: The median age of owner-occupied homes is 40 years old, according to the latest data from the 2022 American Community Survey.

2024.texte: The median age of owner-occupied homes has reached 42 years old, according to the latest data from the 2024 American Community Survey.
